page.overview:
Who is Turr?

Turr was an Andorian who lived in the 23rd century. He was formerly a member of Starfleet, until he was dishonorably discharged by his Human commanding officer for insubordination. This incident led him to hate Humans, though he claimed that he was indifferent to them and objected only to their hypocrisy, i.e. their supposed willingness to discard their high-minded ideals when threatened with death.

Opting to become a mercenary, in 2262 Turr gathered a band of like-minded Andorians and a small arsenal of weapons inside a crystalline cavern on Sigma-2870, a moon located close to a major Federation trade route. Using his familiarity with Federation communications protocols, he set up an SOS designed to lure in a Federation starship. When an away team from the arrived to investigate, he ambushed them and took them prisoner.

Turr demanded that his captives calibrate his communications equipment to mimic Federation transit frequencies, which would enable him to easily prey on passing Federation ships; the codes they input for the task would further allow him to seize control of the Enterprise. To press his point, he stabbed Cadet A'Sha with a toxic crystal shard from the cavern. With A'Sha's condition deteriorating, Ensign Nyota Uhura agreed to assist Turr, with the proviso that he swear an Ushaan to free them afterwards.

However, Uhura's real plan was to modify Turr's equipment to emit a sonic burst, which temporarily disoriented the Andorians and allowed her to grab one of their plasma rifles. During the ensuing firefight, Turr shot Uhura in the shoulder and advanced on her, only for her to fire upwards and cause a large cluster of crystals to fall on and crush him. ()
